description: Upload a local image for a video segment and get a mediaId to use in a segment's media field (generate_persona_video). The file is stored as a temporary engine asset (1 hour TTL, same flow as debug uploads): upload shortly before generating, since a scheduled slot far in the future may outlive the asset — in the images modes an expired mediaId fails the task at render (images_do_not_cover_audio names the photo); full lip sync only warns. JPG/JPEG, PNG, or WebP only, max 8MB (the engine photo limit). The real content type is validated, not the extension. Returns only the mediaId — never a local path or asset URL.

path.description: Local image file path (JPG/JPEG, PNG, or WebP, max 8MB — the engine photo limit, not the 10MB library limit).

name: upload_media
